answers.reason: The full professor holds an office and rank, but participation in the senate is determined by specific regulations or higher office.
Higher office holders are involved in university-wide planning like budget allocation.
Professors are directly involved in the appointment of professorships.
As a member of the faculty with an office, the full professor participates in faculty affairs.
Professors are typically represented in bodies preparing degree programmes and teaching.
Faculty members with academic office take part in examination matters.
Full professors lead research groups and participate in research funding decisions.
As a chair holder and teacher, the professor is involved in module and curriculum work.
Professors leading research and teaching groups take part in equipment procurement.
Orientation week planning is primarily for student integration rather than professorial office.
